description.en: 1,664 claims from 180 papers in machine learning, NLP and medicine, verified against tables and figures. Refuted cases keep the authentic claim and edit the evidence instead, so a refuted item can differ from a supported one only in a small change to a table or figure. The authors report that figure-based verification remains particularly challenging for all models, so a blended score depends on the table/figure mix, and table and figure numbers are not interchangeable.
